queries.query_text: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_stock_records, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, COUNT(DISTINCT product_variant_id) as unique_variants, COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_id) as active_warehouses, SUM(CASE WHEN always_available = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unlimited_items, SUM(CASE WHEN always_available = 'False' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as limited_items FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date

SELECT pm.title as payment_method, COUNT(ot.id) as transaction_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(ot.id) / SUM(COUNT(ot.id)) OVER (), 2) as volume_share_pct, SUM(ot.total) as total_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ot.total) / SUM(SUM(ot.total)) OVER (), 2) as revenue_share_pct, AVG(ot.total) as avg_transaction_value FROM order_transactions ot JOIN payment_methods pm ON ot.payment_method_id = pm.id WHERE ot.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND ot.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY pm.title ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.name as category_name, c.warehouse_id, COUNT(rp.id) as restaurant_count, c.status, c.visibility FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.status = true GROUP BY c.name, c.warehouse_id, c.status, c.visibility HAVING COUNT(rp.id) <= {{max_count}} ORDER BY restaurant_count ASC, c.name LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, d.status, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, d.status), fleet_stats AS (SELECT AVG(delivery_count) as avg_deliveries, STDDEV(delivery_count) as std_dev FROM driver_stats WHERE delivery_count > 0) SELECT ds.id as driver_id, ds.first_name, ds.last_name, ds.warehouse_id, ds.status as is_active, ds.delivery_count, ROUND(fs.avg_deliveries, 2) as fleet_avg, CASE WHEN ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - 2 * fs.std_dev) THEN 'Severely Underutilized' WHEN ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - fs.std_dev) THEN 'Underutilized' WHEN ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + 2 * fs.std_dev) THEN 'Severely Overloaded' WHEN ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + fs.std_dev) THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Normal Range' END as workload_status, ROUND((ds.delivery_count - fs.avg_deliveries) / NULLIF(fs.std_dev, 0), 2) as z_score FROM driver_stats ds CROSS JOIN fleet_stats fs WHERE ds.delivery_count > 0 AND (ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - fs.std_dev) OR ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + fs.std_dev)) ORDER BY z_score DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Variant Proliferation - Category Price Range Analysis
queries.query_text: SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, c.level as category_level, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, MIN(pv.price) as min_price, MAX(pv.price) as max_price, ROUND(AVG(pv.price), 2) as avg_price, ROUND(STDDEV(pv.price), 2) as price_stddev FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.status = true AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.level HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) > 0 ORDER BY variant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH variant_stats AS (SELECT AVG(variant_count) as avg_variants, STDDEV(variant_count) as stddev_variants FROM (SELECT p.id, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = true GROUP BY p.id) t) SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, c.name as category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as unit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.warehouse_id) as warehouse_count, vs.avg_variants, vs.stddev_variants FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN units u ON pv.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id CROSS JOIN variant_stats vs WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = true AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, c.name, vs.avg_variants, vs.stddev_variants HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) > (vs.avg_variants + {{stddev_multiplier}} * vs.stddev_variants) ORDER BY variant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, c.name as category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, MIN(pv.price) as min_price, MAX(pv.price) as max_price, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.warehouse_id) as warehouse_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = true AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) >= {{min_variants}} ORDER BY variant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT pw.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.product_id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as category_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = true THEN p.id END) as active_products FROM product_warehouse pw LEFT JOIN products p ON pw.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY pw.warehouse_id ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as unique_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id), 0), 2) as category_diversity_ratio FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.warehouse_id ORDER BY unique_categories DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT w.id as warehouse_id, w.name as warehouse_name, w.address, COUNT(s.id) as total_items, COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) as unique_products, SUM(CASE WHEN s.always_available = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unlimited_items, AVG(CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC)) as avg_quantity FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.address ORDER BY total_items DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT o.warehouse_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) as order_share_pct, SUM(o.total) as revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.total) / SUM(SUM(o.total)) OVER(), 2) as revenue_share_pct FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' AND o.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.warehouse_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT o.warehouse_id, COUNT(*) as total_orders, SUM(o.total) as total_revenue, AVG(o.total) as avg_order_value, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) as delivered_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as fulfillment_rate FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' AND o.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.warehouse_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id) as restaurant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as category_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rp.featured = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) as featured_percentage FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.warehouse_id ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH total_stock AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date) SELECT w.name as warehouse_name, COUNT(s.id) as items, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(s.id) / total_stock.total, 2) as percentage_of_total, w.status as is_active FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id CROSS JOIN total_stock WHERE s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY w.name, w.status, total_stock.total ORDER BY percentage_of_total DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) as week_start, COUNT(*) as coupons_created, SUM(total_usage) as total_redemptions, SUM(usage_limit) as total_capacity, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total_usage) / NULLIF(SUM(usage_limit), 0), 2) as overall_utilization_pct FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', o.created_at)::date as week_start, COUNT(*) as weekly_orders, SUM(o.total) as weekly_revenue, AVG(o.total) as avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.frontend_user_id) as unique_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' AND o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', o.created_at)::date ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 'Empty Cart' WHEN total < 20000 THEN 'Low Value (< 20K)' WHEN total < 50000 THEN 'Medium Value (20K-50K)' WHEN total < 100000 THEN 'High Value (50K-100K)' ELSE 'Premium (> 100K)' END as cart_value_segment, COUNT(*) as cart_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as abandonment_rate_pct, SUM(total) as total_value FROM carts WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 'Empty Cart' WHEN total < 20000 THEN 'Low Value (< 20K)' WHEN total < 50000 THEN 'Medium Value (20K-50K)' WHEN total < 100000 THEN 'High Value (50K-100K)' ELSE 'Premium (> 100K)' END ORDER BY MIN(total) LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT ad.status as deletion_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ad.user_id) as deleted_users, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ad.user_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frontend_users WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'), 2) as deletion_rate FROM account_deletions ad WHERE ad.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND ad.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY ad.status ORDER BY deleted_users DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_deliveries AS (SELECT d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d INNER JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.status = true AND d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id) SELECT CASE WHEN delivery_count >= 10000 THEN 'High Performer (10k+)' WHEN delivery_count >= 5000 THEN 'Medium Performer (5k-10k)' WHEN delivery_count >= 1000 THEN 'Regular Performer (1k-5k)' ELSE 'Low Performer (<1k)' END as productivity_tier, COUNT(*) as driver_count, MIN(delivery_count) as min_deliveries, MAX(delivery_count) as max_deliveries, ROUND(AVG(delivery_count), 2) as avg_deliveries FROM driver_deliveries GROUP BY productivity_tier ORDER BY min_deliveries DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT 'Coupons' as campaign_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN expiry_date >= '{{start_date}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count, SUM(total_usage) as total_redemptions FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Offers' as campaign_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = true AND end_date >= '{{start_date}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count, NULL as total_redemptions FROM offers WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Discounts' as campaign_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN expiry_date >= '{{start_date}}' AND deleted_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count, NULL as total_redemptions FROM discounts WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Donations' as campaign_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, COUNT(*) as active_count, SUM(donation_amount) as total_redemptions FROM donations WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id) as total_restaurants, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.visibility = true THEN rp.id END) as visible_restaurants, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rp.featured = true THEN rp.id END) as featured_restaurants, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.category_id) as unique_categories FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date

SELECT CASE WHEN expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'No Expiry' WHEN expiry_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Active' WHEN expiry_date <= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Expired' END as lifecycle_stage, COUNT(*) as coupon_count, SUM(total_usage) as cumulative_usage, SUM(usage_limit) as cumulative_limit, ROUND(AVG(discount_value), 2) as avg_discount_value FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY CASE WHEN expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'No Expiry' WHEN expiry_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Active' WHEN expiry_date <= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Expired' END ORDER BY coupon_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Cart Abandonment Rate and Lost Revenue
queries.query_text: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_carts, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_carts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as abandonment_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN total ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_cart_value, AVG(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN total END) as avg_abandoned_cart_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN total ELSE 0 END) as converted_cart_value FROM carts WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_carts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.cart_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.id END) as carts_with_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.cart_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 2) as cart_to_order_pct, SUM(c.total) as total_cart_value, SUM(CASE WHEN c.cart_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.total ELSE 0 END) as converted_cart_value FROM carts c WHERE c.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND c.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT CASE WHEN pv.product_id IS NULL THEN 'No Variants' WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 'No Category' WHEN pw.product_id IS NULL THEN 'No Warehouse' ELSE 'Complete' END as completeness_status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)) OVER (), 2) as percentage FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY CASE WHEN pv.product_id IS NULL THEN 'No Variants' WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 'No Category' WHEN pw.product_id IS NULL THEN 'No Warehouse' ELSE 'Complete' END ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.created_at) as month, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as products_created, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variants_created, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = true THEN p.id END) as active_products, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.visibility = true THEN p.id END) as visible_products FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', p.created_at) ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT p.status as product_status, p.visibility as product_visibility, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.warehouse_id) as warehouse_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY p.status, p.visibility ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as total_products, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = true THEN p.id END) as active_products, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.visibility = true THEN p.id END) as visible_products, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as total_variants, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.product_id) as products_with_warehouse FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}'

SELECT c.name as category_name, COUNT(rp.id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(COUNT(rp.id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(rp.id)) OVER (), 2) as concentration_percentage, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.visibility = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) as visibility_rate FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.level as category_level, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as category_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN product_counts.cnt > 0 THEN product_counts.cnt ELSE 0 END), 2) as avg_products_per_category FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN (SELECT category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT id) as cnt FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY category_id) product_counts ON c.id = product_counts.category_id WHERE c.status = true AND (p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' OR p.id IS NULL) GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY c.level LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.created_at) as month, c.name as category_name, c.level as category_level, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as products_added, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variants_added FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = true AND p.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', p.created_at), c.name, c.level ORDER BY month DESC, products_added DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, c.level as category_level, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = true THEN p.id END) as active_products FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.status = true AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.level ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, c.level as category_level, c.visibility, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 0) as product_count, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id), 0) as variant_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.status = true GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.level, c.visibility HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) < {{min_products}} ORDER BY product_count ASC, c.name LIMIT {{limit}}

result.category_name: 7 Dayz Special Non Veg Main Course

queries.query_text: SELECT c.name as category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rt.closing_time - rt.opening_time)) / 3600), 2) as avg_hours_open, MIN(rt.opening_time) as typical_opening, MAX(rt.closing_time) as typical_closing FROM restaurant_timings rt JOIN categories c ON rt.category_id = c.id JOIN restaurant_profiles rp ON rt.category_id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.status = true GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) >= {{min_restaurants}} ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT code, discount_type, discount_value, total_usage, usage_limit, per_user_limit, ROUND(100.0 * total_usage / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0), 2) as redemption_rate_pct, CASE WHEN total_usage >= usage_limit THEN 'Fully Redeemed' WHEN total_usage * 1.0 / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0) > 0.5 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN total_usage * 1.0 / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0) > 0.1 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Underperformer' END as performance_tier FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' ORDER BY redemption_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT s.product_id, s.product_variant_id, w.name as warehouse_name, CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC) as current_quantity, s.always_available, s.updated_at as last_updated FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.always_available = 'False' AND CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC) < {{threshold}} AND s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date ORDER BY CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC) ASC, s.updated_at DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) as registration_month, COUNT(DISTINCT id) as new_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN id END) as active_customers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0), 2) as active_rate FROM frontend_users WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) ORDER BY registration_month DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id) as total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fu.status = 'active' THEN fu.id END) as active_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fu.status = 'inactive' THEN fu.id END) as inactive_customers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fu.verified = 'True' THEN fu.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id), 0), 2) as email_verification_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fu.id END) as loyalty_participants, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fu.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id), 0), 2) as loyalty_participation_rate, ROUND(AVG(addr_count.address_count), 2) as avg_addresses_per_customer FROM frontend_users fu LEFT JOIN customer_loyalties cl ON fu.id = cl.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as address_count FROM delivery_addresses GROUP BY user_id) addr_count ON fu.id = addr_count.user_id WHERE fu.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND fu.created_at < '{{end_date}}' LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT fu.status, fu.verified, COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id) as customer_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id)) OVER (), 2) as percentage FROM frontend_users fu WHERE fu.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND fu.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY fu.status, fu.verified ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE(created_at) as cart_date, COUNT(*) as carts_created, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as abandonment_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN total ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_value FROM carts WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY cart_date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Daily Driver Activity Trend Over Time
queries.query_text: SELECT DATE(dlh.created_at) as activity_date, COUNT(*) as location_pings, COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id) as active_drivers, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id), 0), 2) as avg_pings_per_driver FROM driver_location_history dlh WHERE dlh.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND dlh.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY DATE(dlh.created_at) ORDER BY activity_date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE(o.created_at) as order_date, COUNT(*) as daily_orders, SUM(o.total) as daily_revenue, AVG(o.total) as avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.frontend_user_id) as unique_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at) ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE(created_at) as transaction_date, COUNT(*) as daily_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate_pct, SUM(total) as daily_revenue FROM order_transactions WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY transaction_date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH daily_stats AS (SELECT DATE(o.created_at) as order_date, COUNT(*) as daily_orders, SUM(o.total) as daily_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' AND o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at)), avg_stats AS (SELECT AVG(daily_revenue) as avg_revenue, STDDEV(daily_revenue) as stddev_revenue FROM daily_stats) SELECT ds.order_date, ds.daily_orders, ds.daily_revenue, ROUND((ds.daily_revenue - av.avg_revenue) / NULLIF(av.stddev_revenue, 0), 2) as z_score, CASE WHEN ds.daily_revenue > av.avg_revenue + 2 * av.stddev_revenue THEN 'High Spike' WHEN ds.daily_revenue < av.avg_revenue - 2 * av.stddev_revenue THEN 'Low Drop' ELSE 'Normal' END as anomaly_type FROM daily_stats ds CROSS JOIN avg_stats av WHERE ABS(ds.daily_revenue - av.avg_revenue) > av.stddev_revenue ORDER BY ABS(ds.daily_revenue - av.avg_revenue) DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT rt.day, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) as restaurant_count, MIN(rt.opening_time) as earliest_opening, MAX(rt.closing_time) as latest_closing, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rt.closing_time - rt.opening_time)) / 3600), 2) as avg_hours_open FROM restaurant_timings rt JOIN restaurant_profiles rp ON rt.category_id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY rt.day ORDER BY CASE rt.day WHEN 'sunday' THEN 1 WHEN 'monday' THEN 2 WHEN 'tuesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 4 WHEN 'thursday' THEN 5 WHEN 'friday' THEN 6 WHEN 'saturday' THEN 7 END LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT product_id, product_variant_id, restaurant_id, old_selling_price, selling_price, (old_selling_price - selling_price) as discount_amount, ROUND(100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0), 2) as discount_pct, start_date, end_date FROM offers WHERE status = true AND start_date >= '{{start_date}}' AND start_date < '{{end_date}}' AND (100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0)) > 30 ORDER BY discount_pct DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Driver Activity by Day of Week Pattern
queries.query_text: SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM dlh.created_at) as day_of_week, CASE EXTRACT(DOW FROM dlh.created_at) WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' END as day_name, COUNT(*) as location_pings, COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id) as unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(dlh.created_at)) as days_observed, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(dlh.created_at)), 0), 2) as avg_pings_per_day FROM driver_location_history dlh WHERE dlh.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND dlh.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM dlh.created_at) ORDER BY day_of_week LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Driver Location Activity by Hour of Day
queries.query_text: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM dlh.created_at) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as location_pings, COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id) as active_drivers, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id), 0), 2) as avg_pings_per_driver FROM driver_location_history dlh WHERE dlh.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND dlh.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM dlh.created_at) ORDER BY hour_of_day LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT d.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as drivers_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status = true THEN d.id END) as active_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.verified = true THEN d.id END) as verified_drivers, COUNT(od.order_id) as total_deliveries, ROUND(COUNT(od.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status = true THEN d.id END), 0), 2) as avg_deliveries_per_driver FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' OR d.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.warehouse_id ORDER BY total_deliveries DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT d.status as is_active, d.verified as is_verified, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as driver_count, COUNT(od.order_id) as deliveries_handled, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT d.id)) OVER (), 2) as pct_of_workforce FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' OR d.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.status, d.verified ORDER BY driver_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as total_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status = true THEN d.id END) as active_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.verified = true THEN d.id END) as verified_drivers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.verified = true THEN d.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d.id), 0), 2) as verification_rate_pct, COUNT(od.order_id) as total_deliveries, ROUND(COUNT(od.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status = true THEN d.id END), 0), 2) as avg_deliveries_per_active_driver FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' OR d.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.status, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND d.created_at <= '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.status) SELECT COUNT(*) as total_drivers, COUNT(CASE WHEN delivery_count > 0 THEN 1 END) as drivers_with_deliveries, COALESCE(MIN(delivery_count), 0) as min_deliveries, COALESCE(MAX(delivery_count), 0) as max_deliveries, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(delivery_count), 0)::numeric, 2) as avg_deliveries, ROUND(COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count), 0)::numeric, 2) as median_deliveries, ROUND(COALESCE(STDDEV(delivery_count), 0)::numeric, 2) as std_dev_deliveries FROM driver_stats LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_deliveries AS (SELECT d.id, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND d.created_at <= '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY d.id), percentiles AS (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p10, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p25, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p50, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p75, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p90, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p95, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p99 FROM driver_deliveries) SELECT 'P10 (Bottom 10%)' as percentile, ROUND(p10::numeric, 2) as delivery_threshold FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P25 (Bottom 25%)', ROUND(p25::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P50 (Median)', ROUND(p50::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P75 (Top 25%)', ROUND(p75::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P90 (Top 10%)', ROUND(p90::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P95 (Top 5%)', ROUND(p95::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P99 (Top 1%)', ROUND(p99::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT rt.day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rt.opening_time < '08:00:00' THEN rt.category_id END) as early_morning_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rt.closing_time > '22:00:00' THEN rt.category_id END) as late_night_count, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) as total_restaurants FROM restaurant_timings rt JOIN restaurant_profiles rp ON rt.category_id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY rt.day ORDER BY CASE rt.day WHEN 'sunday' THEN 1 WHEN 'monday' THEN 2 WHEN 'tuesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 4 WHEN 'thursday' THEN 5 WHEN 'friday' THEN 6 WHEN 'saturday' THEN 7 END LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT code as campaign_identifier, 'Coupon' as type, expiry_date, total_usage, usage_limit, ROUND(100.0 * total_usage / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0), 2) as utilization_pct FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' AND (expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' OR (total_usage * 1.0 / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0)) > 0.8) ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC NULLS LAST, expiry_date ASC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Loyalty Program Participation by Activity Level
queries.query_text: SELECT CASE WHEN loyalty_points::numeric > 0 THEN 'With Loyalty Points' ELSE 'No Loyalty Points' END as loyalty_status, COUNT(DISTINCT id) as customer_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN loyalty_points IS NOT NULL THEN loyalty_points::numeric ELSE 0 END), 2) as avg_loyalty_points, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT id)) OVER (), 2) as percentage FROM frontend_users WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY CASE WHEN loyalty_points::numeric > 0 THEN 'With Loyalty Points' ELSE 'No Loyalty Points' END ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) as month, COUNT(*) as records_added, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as new_products, AVG(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) as avg_starting_quantity FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_id) as warehouse_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT w.name, ', ' ORDER BY w.name) as warehouse_locations, AVG(CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC)) as avg_quantity_across_locations FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_id) > 1 ORDER BY warehouse_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT rt.opening_time, rt.closing_time, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rt.closing_time - rt.opening_time)) / 3600, 2) as hours_open FROM restaurant_timings rt JOIN restaurant_profiles rp ON rt.category_id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY rt.opening_time, rt.closing_time ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as total_orders, SUM(o.total) as total_revenue, AVG(o.total) as average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.frontend_user_id) as unique_customers, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) as delivered_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) as cancelled_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as fulfillment_rate FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1'

SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*) as order_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) as percentage, SUM(o.total) as total_revenue, AVG(o.total) as avg_order_value FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_offers, AVG(selling_price) as avg_selling_price, AVG(old_selling_price) as avg_original_price, AVG(old_selling_price - selling_price) as avg_discount_amount, ROUND(AVG(100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0)), 2) as avg_discount_pct, MIN(100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0)) as min_discount_pct, MAX(100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0)) as max_discount_pct FROM offers WHERE status = true AND start_date >= '{{start_date}}' AND start_date < '{{end_date}}' AND end_date >= CURRENT_DATE LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Overall Payment Success Rate and Transaction Volume
queries.query_text: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_transactions, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_transactions, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as completion_rate_pct, SUM(total) as total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN total ELSE 0 END) as successful_revenue FROM order_transactions WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date

SELECT sr.date, SUM(CASE WHEN sr.platform_ios::int > 0 THEN sr.total_sales ELSE 0 END) as ios_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN sr.platform_android::int > 0 THEN sr.total_sales ELSE 0 END) as android_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN sr.platform_web::int > 0 THEN sr.total_sales ELSE 0 END) as web_revenue, SUM(sr.total_sales) as total_revenue FROM sales_reports sr WHERE sr.date >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND sr.date < '{{end_date}}'::date AND sr.is_daily_report = true GROUP BY sr.date ORDER BY sr.date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT f.favourite as is_favorited, COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) as unique_customers, COUNT(f.id) as total_favorites, ROUND(COUNT(f.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id), 0), 2) as avg_favorites_per_customer FROM favourites f INNER JOIN frontend_users fu ON f.user_id = fu.id WHERE f.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND f.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY f.favourite ORDER BY unique_customers DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.name as category_name, COUNT(rp.id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(COUNT(rp.id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(rp.id)) OVER (), 2) as percentage_share FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.status = true GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT always_available, COUNT(*) as item_count, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, AVG(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) as avg_quantity, MIN(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) as min_quantity, MAX(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) as max_quantity FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY always_available ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) = 0 THEN 'Out of Stock' WHEN CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Critical (1-5)' WHEN CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 'Low (6-10)' WHEN CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 THEN 'Medium (11-50)' ELSE 'Healthy (50+)' END as stock_level_category, COUNT(*) as item_count, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, ROUND(AVG(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)), 2) as avg_quantity FROM stocks WHERE always_available = 'False' AND created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY stock_level_category ORDER BY MIN(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT w.name as warehouse_name, w.address, COUNT(s.id) as stockout_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) as unique_products_out FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.always_available = 'False' AND CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC) = 0 AND s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY w.name, w.address ORDER BY stockout_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT cp.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cart_id) as times_in_abandoned_carts, SUM(cp.quantity) as total_quantity_abandoned, SUM(cp.total) as total_value_abandoned, AVG(cp.unit_price) as avg_unit_price FROM cart_products cp JOIN carts c ON cp.cart_id = c.id WHERE c.cart_order_id IS NULL AND c.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND c.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY cp.product_id ORDER BY times_in_abandoned_carts DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Top Performing Drivers by Delivery Volume

queries.query_text: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_stock_records, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, COUNT(DISTINCT product_variant_id) as unique_variants, COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_id) as active_warehouses, SUM(CASE WHEN always_available = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unlimited_items, SUM(CASE WHEN always_available = 'False' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as limited_items FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date

SELECT c.name as category_name, c.warehouse_id, COUNT(rp.id) as restaurant_count, c.status, c.visibility FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.status = true GROUP BY c.name, c.warehouse_id, c.status, c.visibility HAVING COUNT(rp.id) <= {{max_count}} ORDER BY restaurant_count ASC, c.name LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, d.status, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, d.status), fleet_stats AS (SELECT AVG(delivery_count) as avg_deliveries, STDDEV(delivery_count) as std_dev FROM driver_stats WHERE delivery_count > 0) SELECT ds.id as driver_id, ds.first_name, ds.last_name, ds.warehouse_id, ds.status as is_active, ds.delivery_count, ROUND(fs.avg_deliveries, 2) as fleet_avg, CASE WHEN ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - 2 * fs.std_dev) THEN 'Severely Underutilized' WHEN ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - fs.std_dev) THEN 'Underutilized' WHEN ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + 2 * fs.std_dev) THEN 'Severely Overloaded' WHEN ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + fs.std_dev) THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Normal Range' END as workload_status, ROUND((ds.delivery_count - fs.avg_deliveries) / NULLIF(fs.std_dev, 0), 2) as z_score FROM driver_stats ds CROSS JOIN fleet_stats fs WHERE ds.delivery_count > 0 AND (ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - fs.std_dev) OR ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + fs.std_dev)) ORDER BY z_score DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Variant Proliferation - Category Price Range Analysis
queries.query_text: SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, c.level as category_level, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, MIN(pv.price) as min_price, MAX(pv.price) as max_price, ROUND(AVG(pv.price), 2) as avg_price, ROUND(STDDEV(pv.price), 2) as price_stddev FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.status = true AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.level HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) > 0 ORDER BY variant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH variant_stats AS (SELECT AVG(variant_count) as avg_variants, STDDEV(variant_count) as stddev_variants FROM (SELECT p.id, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = true GROUP BY p.id) t) SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, c.name as category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as unit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.warehouse_id) as warehouse_count, vs.avg_variants, vs.stddev_variants FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN units u ON pv.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id CROSS JOIN variant_stats vs WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = true AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, c.name, vs.avg_variants, vs.stddev_variants HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) > (vs.avg_variants + {{stddev_multiplier}} * vs.stddev_variants) ORDER BY variant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, c.name as category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, MIN(pv.price) as min_price, MAX(pv.price) as max_price, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.warehouse_id) as warehouse_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = true AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) >= {{min_variants}} ORDER BY variant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT pw.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.product_id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as category_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = true THEN p.id END) as active_products FROM product_warehouse pw LEFT JOIN products p ON pw.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY pw.warehouse_id ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as unique_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id), 0), 2) as category_diversity_ratio FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.warehouse_id ORDER BY unique_categories DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT w.id as warehouse_id, w.name as warehouse_name, w.address, COUNT(s.id) as total_items, COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) as unique_products, SUM(CASE WHEN s.always_available = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unlimited_items, AVG(CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC)) as avg_quantity FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.address ORDER BY total_items DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT o.warehouse_id, COUNT(*) as total_orders, SUM(o.total) as total_revenue, AVG(o.total) as avg_order_value, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) as delivered_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as fulfillment_rate FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' AND o.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.warehouse_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id) as restaurant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as category_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rp.featured = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) as featured_percentage FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.warehouse_id ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH total_stock AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date) SELECT w.name as warehouse_name, COUNT(s.id) as items, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(s.id) / total_stock.total, 2) as percentage_of_total, w.status as is_active FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id CROSS JOIN total_stock WHERE s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY w.name, w.status, total_stock.total ORDER BY percentage_of_total DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) as week_start, COUNT(*) as coupons_created, SUM(total_usage) as total_redemptions, SUM(usage_limit) as total_capacity, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(total_usage) / NULLIF(SUM(usage_limit), 0), 2) as overall_utilization_pct FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', o.created_at)::date as week_start, COUNT(*) as weekly_orders, SUM(o.total) as weekly_revenue, AVG(o.total) as avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.frontend_user_id) as unique_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' AND o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', o.created_at)::date ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT ad.status as deletion_status, COUNT(DISTINCT ad.user_id) as deleted_users, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ad.user_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frontend_users WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'), 2) as deletion_rate FROM account_deletions ad WHERE ad.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND ad.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY ad.status ORDER BY deleted_users DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_deliveries AS (SELECT d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d INNER JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.status = true AND d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id) SELECT CASE WHEN delivery_count >= 10000 THEN 'High Performer (10k+)' WHEN delivery_count >= 5000 THEN 'Medium Performer (5k-10k)' WHEN delivery_count >= 1000 THEN 'Regular Performer (1k-5k)' ELSE 'Low Performer (<1k)' END as productivity_tier, COUNT(*) as driver_count, MIN(delivery_count) as min_deliveries, MAX(delivery_count) as max_deliveries, ROUND(AVG(delivery_count), 2) as avg_deliveries FROM driver_deliveries GROUP BY productivity_tier ORDER BY min_deliveries DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT 'Coupons' as campaign_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN expiry_date >= '{{start_date}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count, SUM(total_usage) as total_redemptions FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Offers' as campaign_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = true AND end_date >= '{{start_date}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count, NULL as total_redemptions FROM offers WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Discounts' as campaign_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN expiry_date >= '{{start_date}}' AND deleted_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count, NULL as total_redemptions FROM discounts WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' UNION ALL SELECT 'Donations' as campaign_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, COUNT(*) as active_count, SUM(donation_amount) as total_redemptions FROM donations WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id) as total_restaurants, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.visibility = true THEN rp.id END) as visible_restaurants, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rp.featured = true THEN rp.id END) as featured_restaurants, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.category_id) as unique_categories FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date

SELECT CASE WHEN expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'No Expiry' WHEN expiry_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Active' WHEN expiry_date <= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Expired' END as lifecycle_stage, COUNT(*) as coupon_count, SUM(total_usage) as cumulative_usage, SUM(usage_limit) as cumulative_limit, ROUND(AVG(discount_value), 2) as avg_discount_value FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY CASE WHEN expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'No Expiry' WHEN expiry_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Active' WHEN expiry_date <= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Expired' END ORDER BY coupon_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Cart Abandonment Rate and Lost Revenue
queries.query_text: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_carts, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_carts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as abandonment_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN total ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_cart_value, AVG(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN total END) as avg_abandoned_cart_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN total ELSE 0 END) as converted_cart_value FROM carts WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_carts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.cart_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.id END) as carts_with_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.cart_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 2) as cart_to_order_pct, SUM(c.total) as total_cart_value, SUM(CASE WHEN c.cart_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN c.total ELSE 0 END) as converted_cart_value FROM carts c WHERE c.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND c.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT CASE WHEN pv.product_id IS NULL THEN 'No Variants' WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 'No Category' WHEN pw.product_id IS NULL THEN 'No Warehouse' ELSE 'Complete' END as completeness_status, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)) OVER (), 2) as percentage FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY CASE WHEN pv.product_id IS NULL THEN 'No Variants' WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 'No Category' WHEN pw.product_id IS NULL THEN 'No Warehouse' ELSE 'Complete' END ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT p.status as product_status, p.visibility as product_visibility, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.warehouse_id) as warehouse_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY p.status, p.visibility ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as total_products, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = true THEN p.id END) as active_products, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.visibility = true THEN p.id END) as visible_products, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as total_variants, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.product_id) as products_with_warehouse FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN product_warehouse pw ON p.id = pw.product_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}'

SELECT c.name as category_name, COUNT(rp.id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(COUNT(rp.id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(rp.id)) OVER (), 2) as concentration_percentage, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN c.visibility = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) as visibility_rate FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.level as category_level, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as category_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN product_counts.cnt > 0 THEN product_counts.cnt ELSE 0 END), 2) as avg_products_per_category FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN (SELECT category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT id) as cnt FROM products WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY category_id) product_counts ON c.id = product_counts.category_id WHERE c.status = true AND (p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' OR p.id IS NULL) GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY c.level LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, c.level as category_level, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id) as variant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = true THEN p.id END) as active_products FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.status = true AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.level ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, c.level as category_level, c.visibility, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 0) as product_count, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pv.id), 0) as variant_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND p.updated_at < '{{end_date}}' LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON p.id = pv.product_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.status = true GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.level, c.visibility HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) < {{min_products}} ORDER BY product_count ASC, c.name LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_text: SELECT c.name as category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rt.closing_time - rt.opening_time)) / 3600), 2) as avg_hours_open, MIN(rt.opening_time) as typical_opening, MAX(rt.closing_time) as typical_closing FROM restaurant_timings rt JOIN categories c ON rt.category_id = c.id JOIN restaurant_profiles rp ON rt.category_id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.status = true GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) >= {{min_restaurants}} ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT code, discount_type, discount_value, total_usage, usage_limit, per_user_limit, ROUND(100.0 * total_usage / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0), 2) as redemption_rate_pct, CASE WHEN total_usage >= usage_limit THEN 'Fully Redeemed' WHEN total_usage * 1.0 / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0) > 0.5 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN total_usage * 1.0 / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0) > 0.1 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Underperformer' END as performance_tier FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' ORDER BY redemption_rate_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT s.product_id, s.product_variant_id, w.name as warehouse_name, CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC) as current_quantity, s.always_available, s.updated_at as last_updated FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.always_available = 'False' AND CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC) < {{threshold}} AND s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date ORDER BY CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC) ASC, s.updated_at DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id) as total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fu.status = 'active' THEN fu.id END) as active_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fu.status = 'inactive' THEN fu.id END) as inactive_customers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fu.verified = 'True' THEN fu.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id), 0), 2) as email_verification_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fu.id END) as loyalty_participants, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fu.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id), 0), 2) as loyalty_participation_rate, ROUND(AVG(addr_count.address_count), 2) as avg_addresses_per_customer FROM frontend_users fu LEFT JOIN customer_loyalties cl ON fu.id = cl.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as address_count FROM delivery_addresses GROUP BY user_id) addr_count ON fu.id = addr_count.user_id WHERE fu.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND fu.created_at < '{{end_date}}' LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT fu.status, fu.verified, COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id) as customer_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT fu.id)) OVER (), 2) as percentage FROM frontend_users fu WHERE fu.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND fu.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY fu.status, fu.verified ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE(created_at) as cart_date, COUNT(*) as carts_created, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as abandonment_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN cart_order_id IS NULL THEN total ELSE 0 END) as abandoned_value FROM carts WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY cart_date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Daily Driver Activity Trend Over Time
queries.query_text: SELECT DATE(dlh.created_at) as activity_date, COUNT(*) as location_pings, COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id) as active_drivers, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id), 0), 2) as avg_pings_per_driver FROM driver_location_history dlh WHERE dlh.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND dlh.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY DATE(dlh.created_at) ORDER BY activity_date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE(o.created_at) as order_date, COUNT(*) as daily_orders, SUM(o.total) as daily_revenue, AVG(o.total) as avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.frontend_user_id) as unique_customers FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at) ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT DATE(created_at) as transaction_date, COUNT(*) as daily_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate_pct, SUM(total) as daily_revenue FROM order_transactions WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY transaction_date DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH daily_stats AS (SELECT DATE(o.created_at) as order_date, COUNT(*) as daily_orders, SUM(o.total) as daily_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' AND o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at)), avg_stats AS (SELECT AVG(daily_revenue) as avg_revenue, STDDEV(daily_revenue) as stddev_revenue FROM daily_stats) SELECT ds.order_date, ds.daily_orders, ds.daily_revenue, ROUND((ds.daily_revenue - av.avg_revenue) / NULLIF(av.stddev_revenue, 0), 2) as z_score, CASE WHEN ds.daily_revenue > av.avg_revenue + 2 * av.stddev_revenue THEN 'High Spike' WHEN ds.daily_revenue < av.avg_revenue - 2 * av.stddev_revenue THEN 'Low Drop' ELSE 'Normal' END as anomaly_type FROM daily_stats ds CROSS JOIN avg_stats av WHERE ABS(ds.daily_revenue - av.avg_revenue) > av.stddev_revenue ORDER BY ABS(ds.daily_revenue - av.avg_revenue) DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT rt.day, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) as restaurant_count, MIN(rt.opening_time) as earliest_opening, MAX(rt.closing_time) as latest_closing, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rt.closing_time - rt.opening_time)) / 3600), 2) as avg_hours_open FROM restaurant_timings rt JOIN restaurant_profiles rp ON rt.category_id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY rt.day ORDER BY CASE rt.day WHEN 'sunday' THEN 1 WHEN 'monday' THEN 2 WHEN 'tuesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 4 WHEN 'thursday' THEN 5 WHEN 'friday' THEN 6 WHEN 'saturday' THEN 7 END LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT product_id, product_variant_id, restaurant_id, old_selling_price, selling_price, (old_selling_price - selling_price) as discount_amount, ROUND(100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0), 2) as discount_pct, start_date, end_date FROM offers WHERE status = true AND start_date >= '{{start_date}}' AND start_date < '{{end_date}}' AND (100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0)) > 30 ORDER BY discount_pct DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Driver Activity by Day of Week Pattern
queries.query_text: SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM dlh.created_at) as day_of_week, CASE EXTRACT(DOW FROM dlh.created_at) WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday' WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' END as day_name, COUNT(*) as location_pings, COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id) as unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(dlh.created_at)) as days_observed, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(dlh.created_at)), 0), 2) as avg_pings_per_day FROM driver_location_history dlh WHERE dlh.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND dlh.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM dlh.created_at) ORDER BY day_of_week LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Driver Location Activity by Hour of Day
queries.query_text: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM dlh.created_at) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as location_pings, COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id) as active_drivers, ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT dlh.driver_id), 0), 2) as avg_pings_per_driver FROM driver_location_history dlh WHERE dlh.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND dlh.created_at < '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM dlh.created_at) ORDER BY hour_of_day LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT d.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as drivers_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status = true THEN d.id END) as active_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.verified = true THEN d.id END) as verified_drivers, COUNT(od.order_id) as total_deliveries, ROUND(COUNT(od.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status = true THEN d.id END), 0), 2) as avg_deliveries_per_driver FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' OR d.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.warehouse_id ORDER BY total_deliveries DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT d.status as is_active, d.verified as is_verified, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as driver_count, COUNT(od.order_id) as deliveries_handled, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT d.id)) OVER (), 2) as pct_of_workforce FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' OR d.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.status, d.verified ORDER BY driver_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) as total_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status = true THEN d.id END) as active_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.verified = true THEN d.id END) as verified_drivers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.verified = true THEN d.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d.id), 0), 2) as verification_rate_pct, COUNT(od.order_id) as total_deliveries, ROUND(COUNT(od.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.status = true THEN d.id END), 0), 2) as avg_deliveries_per_active_driver FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' OR d.updated_at >= '{{start_date}}' LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.status, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND d.created_at <= '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.status) SELECT COUNT(*) as total_drivers, COUNT(CASE WHEN delivery_count > 0 THEN 1 END) as drivers_with_deliveries, COALESCE(MIN(delivery_count), 0) as min_deliveries, COALESCE(MAX(delivery_count), 0) as max_deliveries, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(delivery_count), 0)::numeric, 2) as avg_deliveries, ROUND(COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count), 0)::numeric, 2) as median_deliveries, ROUND(COALESCE(STDDEV(delivery_count), 0)::numeric, 2) as std_dev_deliveries FROM driver_stats LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_deliveries AS (SELECT d.id, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND d.created_at <= '{{end_date}}' GROUP BY d.id), percentiles AS (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p10, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p25, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p50, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p75, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p90, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p95, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delivery_count) as p99 FROM driver_deliveries) SELECT 'P10 (Bottom 10%)' as percentile, ROUND(p10::numeric, 2) as delivery_threshold FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P25 (Bottom 25%)', ROUND(p25::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P50 (Median)', ROUND(p50::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P75 (Top 25%)', ROUND(p75::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P90 (Top 10%)', ROUND(p90::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P95 (Top 5%)', ROUND(p95::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles UNION ALL SELECT 'P99 (Top 1%)', ROUND(p99::numeric, 2) FROM percentiles LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT rt.day, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rt.opening_time < '08:00:00' THEN rt.category_id END) as early_morning_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rt.closing_time > '22:00:00' THEN rt.category_id END) as late_night_count, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) as total_restaurants FROM restaurant_timings rt JOIN restaurant_profiles rp ON rt.category_id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY rt.day ORDER BY CASE rt.day WHEN 'sunday' THEN 1 WHEN 'monday' THEN 2 WHEN 'tuesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 4 WHEN 'thursday' THEN 5 WHEN 'friday' THEN 6 WHEN 'saturday' THEN 7 END LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT code as campaign_identifier, 'Coupon' as type, expiry_date, total_usage, usage_limit, ROUND(100.0 * total_usage / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0), 2) as utilization_pct FROM coupons WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}' AND created_at < '{{end_date}}' AND (expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' OR (total_usage * 1.0 / NULLIF(usage_limit, 0)) > 0.8) ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC NULLS LAST, expiry_date ASC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT rt.opening_time, rt.closing_time, COUNT(DISTINCT rt.category_id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rt.closing_time - rt.opening_time)) / 3600, 2) as hours_open FROM restaurant_timings rt JOIN restaurant_profiles rp ON rt.category_id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY rt.opening_time, rt.closing_time ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as total_orders, SUM(o.total) as total_revenue, AVG(o.total) as average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.frontend_user_id) as unique_customers, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) as delivered_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) as cancelled_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as fulfillment_rate FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1'

SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*) as order_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) as percentage, SUM(o.total) as total_revenue, AVG(o.total) as avg_order_value FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_offers, AVG(selling_price) as avg_selling_price, AVG(old_selling_price) as avg_original_price, AVG(old_selling_price - selling_price) as avg_discount_amount, ROUND(AVG(100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0)), 2) as avg_discount_pct, MIN(100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0)) as min_discount_pct, MAX(100.0 * (old_selling_price - selling_price) / NULLIF(old_selling_price, 0)) as max_discount_pct FROM offers WHERE status = true AND start_date >= '{{start_date}}' AND start_date < '{{end_date}}' AND end_date >= CURRENT_DATE LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Overall Payment Success Rate and Transaction Volume
queries.query_text: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_transactions, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_transactions, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as completion_rate_pct, SUM(total) as total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN status = true THEN total ELSE 0 END) as successful_revenue FROM order_transactions WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date

SELECT c.name as category_name, COUNT(rp.id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(COUNT(rp.id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(rp.id)) OVER (), 2) as percentage_share FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.status = true GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT always_available, COUNT(*) as item_count, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, AVG(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) as avg_quantity, MIN(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) as min_quantity, MAX(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) as max_quantity FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY always_available ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) = 0 THEN 'Out of Stock' WHEN CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Critical (1-5)' WHEN CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 'Low (6-10)' WHEN CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC) BETWEEN 11 AND 50 THEN 'Medium (11-50)' ELSE 'Healthy (50+)' END as stock_level_category, COUNT(*) as item_count, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, ROUND(AVG(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)), 2) as avg_quantity FROM stocks WHERE always_available = 'False' AND created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY stock_level_category ORDER BY MIN(CAST(quantity AS NUMERIC)) LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT w.name as warehouse_name, w.address, COUNT(s.id) as stockout_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) as unique_products_out FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.always_available = 'False' AND CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC) = 0 AND s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY w.name, w.address ORDER BY stockout_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.query_name: Top Performing Drivers by Delivery Volume
queries.query_text: SELECT d.id as driver_id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, d.status as is_active, d.verified as is_verified, COUNT(od.order_id) as total_deliveries, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(od.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(od.order_id)) OVER (), 2) as pct_of_total_deliveries, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(od.order_id) DESC) as delivery_rank FROM drivers d INNER JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, d.status, d.verified HAVING COUNT(od.order_id) > 0 ORDER BY total_deliveries DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT op.title as product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) as order_count, SUM(op.quantity) as total_quantity_sold, SUM(op.total) as total_revenue, AVG(op.unit_price) as avg_unit_price FROM order_products op INNER JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND o.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND o.status = '1' GROUP BY op.title ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT {{limit}}
