queries.query_text: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_stock_records, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as unique_products, COUNT(DISTINCT product_variant_id) as unique_variants, COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_id) as active_warehouses, SUM(CASE WHEN always_available = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unlimited_items, SUM(CASE WHEN always_available = 'False' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as limited_items FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date

SELECT c.name as category_name, c.warehouse_id, COUNT(rp.id) as restaurant_count, c.status, c.visibility FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.status = true GROUP BY c.name, c.warehouse_id, c.status, c.visibility HAVING COUNT(rp.id) <= {{max_count}} ORDER BY restaurant_count ASC, c.name LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, d.status, COUNT(od.order_id) as delivery_count FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN order_driver od ON d.id = od.driver_id WHERE d.created_at >= '{{start_date}}' GROUP BY d.id, d.first_name, d.last_name, d.warehouse_id, d.status), fleet_stats AS (SELECT AVG(delivery_count) as avg_deliveries, STDDEV(delivery_count) as std_dev FROM driver_stats WHERE delivery_count > 0) SELECT ds.id as driver_id, ds.first_name, ds.last_name, ds.warehouse_id, ds.status as is_active, ds.delivery_count, ROUND(fs.avg_deliveries, 2) as fleet_avg, CASE WHEN ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - 2 * fs.std_dev) THEN 'Severely Underutilized' WHEN ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - fs.std_dev) THEN 'Underutilized' WHEN ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + 2 * fs.std_dev) THEN 'Severely Overloaded' WHEN ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + fs.std_dev) THEN 'Overloaded' ELSE 'Normal Range' END as workload_status, ROUND((ds.delivery_count - fs.avg_deliveries) / NULLIF(fs.std_dev, 0), 2) as z_score FROM driver_stats ds CROSS JOIN fleet_stats fs WHERE ds.delivery_count > 0 AND (ds.delivery_count < (fs.avg_deliveries - fs.std_dev) OR ds.delivery_count > (fs.avg_deliveries + fs.std_dev)) ORDER BY z_score DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as unique_categories, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id) as restaurant_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id), 0), 2) as category_diversity_ratio FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.warehouse_id ORDER BY unique_categories DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT w.id as warehouse_id, w.name as warehouse_name, w.address, COUNT(s.id) as total_items, COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) as unique_products, SUM(CASE WHEN s.always_available = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unlimited_items, AVG(CAST(s.quantity AS NUMERIC)) as avg_quantity FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY w.id, w.name, w.address ORDER BY total_items DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

SELECT c.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.id) as restaurant_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as category_count, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rp.featured = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) as featured_percentage FROM restaurant_profiles rp JOIN categories c ON rp.category_id = c.id WHERE rp.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND rp.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date AND c.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.warehouse_id ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC LIMIT {{limit}}

WITH total_stock AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM stocks WHERE created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date) SELECT w.name as warehouse_name, COUNT(s.id) as items, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(s.id) / total_stock.total, 2) as percentage_of_total, w.status as is_active FROM stocks s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id CROSS JOIN total_stock WHERE s.created_at >= '{{start_date}}'::date AND s.created_at < '{{end_date}}'::date GROUP BY w.name, w.status, total_stock.total ORDER BY percentage_of_total DESC LIMIT {{limit}}
